title: human_actions
tagline: one-click on-chain activity aggregator for real humans, the answer to farming bots

prizes.placement: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer
prizes.title: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer

description:
Is it not already enough that you are a real human person working in crypto. Yet most of us miss out on great opportunities that come with being a highly active 'farmer'.

This is a one-click UI that lets you automate all your on-chain efforts, once proven you are human ... the answer to farming bots, doing non-human activity.
how_its_made:
- NEXT JS
- EXPRESS
- SOLIDITY
- PRIVY WALLET

Basically all the things needed to make a project like this run. It mostly consists of scripts for doing all the on-chain actions triggered by the user.

We mainly used remix to deploy the contracts across different EVMs
Furthermore, we used Worldcoin and WorldID to verify the user as real human
